RULEBOOK.TITLE: Hong Kong 4P & Malaysian 3P · Fan & Payout Schedule
RULEBOOK.TIER_1: 1 Fan: All Chows, Dragon Pong, Round/Seat Wind, 3P North Wind, Self-Draw, Concealed Hand, No Flowers, Seat Flower, Robbing Kong, Kong Replacement, Last Tile; 3P Bonus: Animal (+1 each), Cat+Mouse (+1), Rooster+Centipede (+1), Face Pair (+1), Exposed Fly (+1).
RULEBOOK.TIER_2: 2 Fan: Complete Flower/Season Set (4 of a group), All 4 Faces (3P).
RULEBOOK.TIER_3: 3 Fan: Mixed One Suit (Half Flush), All Pongs.
RULEBOOK.TIER_4: 4 Fan: Seven Pairs (optional), Mixed Terminals & Honors.
RULEBOOK.TIER_5_8: 5–8 Fan: Small Three Dragons (5), Small Four Winds (6), Pure One Suit / Full Flush (7), Big Three Dragons (8), Four Concealed Pongs (8).
RULEBOOK.TIER_LIMIT: 10 Fan Limit: Thirteen Orphans, Big Four Winds, All Honors, All Terminals, Nine Gates, Eight Immortals, Four Flys Instant Win (3P), Heavenly/Earthly Hand.
RULEBOOK.MAHJONG_FLY_NOTE: 3P Fly Mechanics: Strictly 3 seats (East/South/West) with 84 tiles. Meld Pong/Kong/Chow with Fly wildcards, click Retrieve Fly on your turn to swap a matching natural tile for an open meld's Fly, or click Expose Fly for +1 Fan & replacement draw. Holding all 4 Flys wins instantly (10-Fan Limit)!
RULEBOOK.PENALTY_NOTE: Penalties: Action buttons stay active at all times. False Hu pays 2× min-Fan base to each opponent; Wrong Pong/Kong/Chow/Fly pays 1× min-Fan base to each opponent.
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_TITLE: Malaysia Landmarks Monopoly · Saidina & Tycoon Rules
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_RULE_1: Starting Capital & GO: Every player starts with RM 1,500 on Space 0 (GO). Passing or landing on GO pays RM 200 salary.
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_RULE_2: Saidina House Rule — Free Parking Jackpot: Pot starts seeded at RM 100. All Income/Luxury Taxes and Chance/Community Chest fines accumulate in the center pot; landing on Space 20 (Free Parking) sweeps the entire pot!
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_RULE_3: Saidina House Rule — Jail Rent Freeze: While locked in Jail (Space 10), an owner collects RM 0 rent on all owned landmarks, transits, and utilities. Exit via Doubles, RM 50 bail, or Get Out of Jail card.
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_RULE_4: Monopoly & Auctions: Owning a full color group doubles base land rent and unlocks even house building (up to 4 Houses + 1 Hotel). Passing an unowned space triggers live bidding when Auctions are enabled.
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_RULE_5: Victory Modes: Play Last Tycoon Standing (elimination until one tycoon remains solvent) or Round Limit (highest total Net Worth = Cash + Land + Buildings + Mortgaged Value wins at the round cap).
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_ROW_TRANSIT_TYPE: Transit Hubs (KL Sentral / Port Klang / Penang Bridge / KLIA)
RULEBOOK.MONOPOLY_ROW_TAX_EFFECT: RM 200 / RM 100 → Paid into Jackpot Pot
RULEBOOK.AVALON_TITLE: The Resistance: Avalon · Social Deduction & Quest Rules
RULEBOOK.AVALON_RULE_1: Allegiances & Privacy Shield: Knights are secretly assigned to Good (Loyal to Arthur) or Evil (Minions of Mordred). Hold or toggle the Privacy Shield to inspect your secret role and Night Vision clues safely.
RULEBOOK.AVALON_RULE_2: Special Roles: Merlin sees Evil (except Mordred); Percival sees Merlin & Morgana without knowing which is true; Oberon is Evil but hidden from fellow Evil allies; Assassin strikes if Good completes 3 Quests.
RULEBOOK.AVALON_RULE_3: Proposal & 5-Vote Hammer: The Leader nominates a Quest team and all players vote Approve or Reject simultaneously. Majority Approve launches the Quest; 5 consecutive Rejections in one Quest hand immediate victory to Evil!
RULEBOOK.AVALON_RULE_4: Secret Quest Cards: Team members submit Quest Cards secretly. Good knights can ONLY submit Success; Evil minions may submit Success or Fail. Usually 1 Fail sabotages the Quest (Quest 4 at 7–10 players requires 2 Fails).
RULEBOOK.AVALON_RULE_5: Endgame & Lady of the Lake: Evil wins if 3 Quests fail or 5 proposals are rejected. If Good completes 3 Quests, Evil gets one final chance: if the Assassin kills Merlin, Evil steals the win! Optional Lady of the Lake inspects loyalty after Quests 2, 3, and 4.
